title: Depletion of nuclear LINE1 RNA in mouse ESCs and embryos
protocol: Warm up all media and trypsin to 37°C.
Warm up nucleofection solution to 20°C–23°C.
Add 2 mL 0.1% gelatin to 2 wells of a 6-well tissue culture plate per ASO and plate in the incubator.
Thaw ASOs on ice.
Wash each well of ESCs with 1-2 mL PBS before adding 0.5 mL TrypLE Express reagent to dissociate cells.
Place in the incubator for 4–5 min to allow cells to detach.
Pipette ESCs up and down 4–5 times with a P1000 pipette to achieve a single cell suspension.
Transfer to a 15 mL conical tube and neutralize with >2× volume of fresh ESC medium.
Count the total live number of ESCs in the tube.
Transfer 5e6 cells per ASO to a new 15 mL conical tube, and centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min to pellet cells.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL PBS to wash.
Pellet as before.
Set Nucleofector device to program A023.
Remove gelatin from 6-well plate.
Add 2 mL ESC medium to each well of the 6-well plate.
Aspirate PBS from the sample.
Resuspend ESC pellet in 95 μL nucleofection solution per sample, pipetting up and down only 1–2 times.
Transfer 95 μL to the bottom of each nucleofection cuvette.
Add 5 μL of ASO to the cells in each cuvette.
Flick gently a few times to mix the ASO with the cells.
Insert the cuvette into the Nucleofector device and press the button to nucleofect each sample.
Take the cuvette(s) back to the tissue culture hood.
Pipette 0.5 mL ESC medium into each cuvette.
Carefully obtain all the medium containing the nucleofected cells using a Pasteur pipette, avoiding any precipitate.
Add the cells dropwise to 2 wells of the 6-well plate that already contains ESC media.
Repeat for the other sample(s).
Gently shake the plate to evenly disperse the cells.
Return the plate to the incubator to allow ESCs to recover and adhere.
Change the medium on each sample the next day.
Check nucleofection efficiency under a fluorescent microscope after 24 hours.
Proceed with RNA FISH or other downstream applications after 48 hours post-nucleofection.
Coat glass coverslips with poly-L-lysine solution.
Place coated coverslips in each well of a 12-well plate.
Rinse coverslips with sterile H2O and air dry.
Chill 70% RNAse-free ethanol at -20°C for later use.
Trypsinize ESCs and count cells.
Resuspend ESCs to achieve a concentration of 150,000 cells/mL.
Transfer 1 mL of cell suspension (150,000 cells) to each well containing coated coverslips.
Gently shake the plate to disperse the cells evenly.
Place the plate in an incubator and allow ESCs to adhere for at least 4 hours.
Check ESC adhesion by gently agitating the dish and observing cell movement.
Leave ESCs in the incubator for an additional hour if not fully adhered.
Wash ESCs once with 1-2 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL of 4% PFA solution to each well and fix cells at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Discard PFA and wash once with PBS.
Remove and add a fresh change of 70% ethanol.
Store plates at 4°C overnight (minimum 15-18 hours) before proceeding.
Rehydrate coverslips by replacing ethanol with FISH Wash Buffer.
Replace with a second change of FISH Wash Buffer and leave to rehydrate for at least 5 minutes.
Thaw an aliquot of hybridization buffer (100 μL per coverslip) and thaw the LINE1 Orf2 RNA FISH probes.
Add 0.5 μL probe (approximately 6.25 pmol) and 1 μL RNAse-OUT inhibitor to each 100 μL of hybridization buffer.
Place a piece of parafilm in a lightproof tissue culture dish, labeled for each condition.
Pipette 100 μL of probe in hybridization buffer onto the parafilm per coverslip.
Use coverslip forceps to pick up each coverslip and deposit face down onto the HB.
Incubate in a hybridization oven at 37°C for 45–60 minutes, then at 30°C overnight (approximately 16–18 hours).
Prewarm wash buffer to 30°C–37°C.
Right before use, add RNAse-OUT to the correct volume needed for washes (1–2 mL per coverslip per wash).
Take out the dish containing coverslips.
Gently pipette some WB between the coverslip and parafilm to allow the coverslip to float.
Remove the coverslip face up into a 12-well or 6-well dish containing WB.
Remove this wash and replace with fresh WB.
Incubate at 30°C, protected from light.
Add fresh WB plus DAPI solution (1:1000) and leave for 15–30 min.
Blot the edge of the coverslip to remove excess WB.
Place face down on a drop of Vectashield on a microscope slide.
Press down gently to remove excess Vectashield, blot away.
Leave to dry protected from light for 15–30 min before sealing with nail varnish.
Image cells on a widefield microscope at 100× oil-immersion magnification.
Collect data from the far-red channel before other channels to prevent photobleaching.
Use an exposure time of 4–5 seconds for optimal visualization.
Collect Z-stacks every 0.25 μm using MetaMorph software.
Create max projections in FIJI for subsequent quantification.
Quantify RNA FISH foci numbers per cell using StarSearch free online software.
Manually draw around each nuclear outline to quantify FISH foci per nucleus.
Maintain the same threshold across images for consistent results.
Sacrifice mice at approximately 24 hours post hCG administration for zygote collection.
Collect zygotes by flushing M2 medium into the infundibulum using a 30.5 gauge needle and syringe or tearing apart ampulla to release embryos.
Use 300 μL of M2 medium with Hyaluronidase (300 μg/mL) to dissociate cumulus cells attached to the embryos.
Pull injection pipettes using P-97 micropipette puller.
Adjust injection parameters according to the Ramp test.
Bend pulled injection pipettes by microforge.
Set heater level at ∼50 and bend the pipettes to an angle of 10–15 degrees.
Centrifuge ASOs at approximately 16,000 g for 10 minutes to pellet any possible debris or particles.
Prepare injection dishes.
Set up both holding and injection pipettes.
Load approximately 0.5 μl of injection solution to the end of injection pipettes by dispensing from a P2 pipette.
Allow injection pipettes to fill with the injection solution via capillary action.
Ensure that the injection solution moves to the tip of the pipette through capillary action.
Fit the holding pipette to the pneumatic injector.
Lower the holding pipette into the injection drops.
Aspirate the medium using the holding pipette.
Equilibrate the pressure using the pressure release valve.
Disconnect the injection tube before turning on the Femtojet 4i.
Switch on the Femtojet 4i.
Re-connect the injection tube after switching on.
Wait for sufficient pressure to build up for injection.
Apply Clean function to remove air bubbles and debris.
Adjust injection parameters to automatic mode.
Set pi (Injection pressure) between 3–4.
Set ti (Injection time) to 1.5 seconds.
Set pc (Compensation pressure) to 2.
Set pw (Compensation pressure, continuous flow) to 1–2 if needed.
Ensure positive hydrostatic pressure is maintained.
Avoid negative pressure and sucking of medium for injection.
Perform microinjection at room temperature.
Microinject zygotes with Standard Control, Reverse Complement (RC), or LINE1 ASOs.
Use ASO solutions from a stock concentration of 1.5 mM (1×) or 0.75 mM (0.5×).
Inject 2–5 pl of solution per injection into the cytoplasm.
For late 2-cell stage injection, inject both blastomeres.
Aspirate the zygote using the holding pipette under negative pressure.
Adjust the focus on the injection pipette.
Insert the injection pipette into the cytoplasm of the zygote, avoiding the pronuclei.
Apply the injection pressure using the foot control pedal.
Withdraw the injection pipette quickly after applying pressure.
Release the zygote by applying positive pressure on the holding pipette.
Move the injected zygote using the injection pipette.
Repeat the microinjection procedure until all zygotes have been injected.
Apply negative pressure to aspirate the 2-cell embryo using the holding pipette.
Adjust the focus on the injection pipette.
Insert the injection pipette into the cytoplasm of one blastomere (avoiding the nuclei).
Apply the injection pressure by using the foot control pedal.
Withdraw the injection pipette quickly.
Repeat the injection procedure for the other blastomere.
Release the 2-cell embryo by applying positive pressure to the holding pipette.
Move the injected 2-cell embryo using the injection pipette.
Repeat the microinjection procedure until all embryos have been injected.
Culture embryos in equilibrated KSOM medium (at least 2 hours in the incubator) in KSOM drops (∼80 μL, covered with mineral oil).
Fix embryos injected at the zygote stage in pre-cooled 100% methanol for 20 minutes.
Quickly wash fixed embryos in ice cold 50% methanol and transfer into PBS/PVA for rehydration for 10 minutes.
Incubate embryos in 70% ethanol for 20 minutes at room temperature to permeabilize them.
Transfer permeabilized embryos to the next row of a 96 well plate containing 10% formamide wash buffer for equilibration at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Culture embryos with probes diluted in hybridization buffer in microdrops of 80 μL in a 60 mm dish overlaid with mineral at 37°C overnight (8–12 h).
Wash embryos in 10% formamide wash buffer with Tween-20 (eWB+T) at 37°C for 30 min.
Counterstain embryos in 10% wash buffer with Tween-20 containing DAPI (eWB+T+DAPI) at 37°C for 30 min.
Place embryos into the middle of a slide and add four small droplets of soft wax around the area to act as a buffer space.
Apply a coverslip over the embryos and use a pencil to gently squeeze down to immobilize the embryos without squashing them.
Apply Vectashield medium to the edge of the coverslip, allowing it to fill the space and mount the embryos.
Absorb surplus medium using a Kimwipe tissue.
Seal the coverslip with clear nail polish.
